name: Harm

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

targets.description: a creature you can see within range

summary: Con save or 14d6 Necrotic and a lowered Hit Point maximum; half damage only on a success.
text: On a failure the target's Hit Point maximum drops by the Necrotic damage it took, to no lower than 1.
